description: Register a company (by CUI) to monitor. Stores a fingerprint of its current registry record as the baseline; poll_watchlist then reports changes between monthly ONRC snapshots - a new director, a new CAEN activity, an address or status change - and when ANAF declares it fiscally inactive or its VAT status flips.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI) of the firm to watch, e.g. '2816464'. Watching a firm you already watch changes nothing.
cui.title: Cui

name: watch_company

outputSchema.description: The watch registered (or already held) for the firm.

alreadyWatching.description: true when you already held this watch (nothing changed).

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

ok.description: true when the watch is in place.

watch.description: kind, target, owner (key prefix), county, baseline.

title: Watch a company for changes
